[[File:Star Wars Destiny original rules reference logo.png|thumb|Original Star Wars: Destiny game logo.]]
'''Star Wars: Destiny''' is a two-player collectible dice and card game designed by Lukas Litzsinger and Corey Konieczka and first published by Fantasy Flight Games in 2016.<ref name="rules">[https://images-cdn.fantasyflightgames.com/filer_public/e1/2e/e12eefc9-4310-44c5-bae5-1edd18453b78/swd_rules_reference_11.pdf Star Wars: Destiny Rules Reference 1.1], Fantasy Flight Games, credits. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200301071324/https://images-cdn.fantasyflightgames.com/filer_public/e1/2e/e12eefc9-4310-44c5-bae5-1edd18453b78/swd_rules_reference_11.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="launch">[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2016/7/29/star-wars-destiny/ Star Wars: Destiny], Fantasy Flight Games, 29 July 2016. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250804055612/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2016/7/29/star-wars-destiny/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Gameplay ==

Players assemble teams of Star Wars characters and take turns playing cards, activating characters, and resolving dice. A player wins by defeating all opposing characters or by exhausting the opponent's hand and deck at the end of a round.<ref name="rules" />

== Publication ==

The initial ''Awakenings'' release included boosters and Rey and Kylo Ren starter sets.<ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2017/2/28/there-has-been-an-awakening-1/ There Has Been an Awakening], Fantasy Flight Games, 28 February 2017. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250418073442/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2017/2/28/there-has-been-an-awakening-1/ Internet Archive].</ref> Fantasy Flight Games announced the end of the game in January 2020, naming ''Covert Missions'' as its final commercial product. ''Covert Missions'' reached retailers on 6 March 2020.<ref>[https://www.jedinews.com/gaming/articles/the-saga-concludes-for-star-wars-destiny/ The Saga Concludes for Star Wars: Destiny], Fantasy Flight Games statement reproduced by Jedi News, 17 January 2020. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107203951/https://www.jedinews.com/gaming/articles/the-saga-concludes-for-star-wars-destiny/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2020/3/6/available-now-march-6/ Available Now – March 6], Fantasy Flight Games, 6 March 2020. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250710233059/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2020/3/6/available-now-march-6/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Online play ==

The [[TCGMix]] playtest uses the ''Awakenings'' base set and offers a bot opponent.<ref name="catalog" />

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/swdestiny/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-star-wars-destiny">[https://tcgmix.com/swdestiny/ Play Star Wars Destiny], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194909/https://tcgmix.com/swdestiny/ Internet Archive].</ref>
